reply: Thank you for telling us that collection accounts on your report contain information you believe is inaccurate. We understand you want them reviewed. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please list each collection and explain what is wrong with it. If the company that supplied the information finds it was wrong, it must notify every credit reporting company it reported to. Keep copies of your disputes. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $5,000.00 lease balance is being collected after you ended your lease early to move into your new home, and that the collector has not sent the lease or a rent ledger. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep your rent payment records, move-out proof and validation requests, and keep disputing in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you requested validation of a debt you believe is not yours, did not receive it, and continued to receive calls and letters. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a copy of your validation request and a record of every call and letter received after it. Continue to dispute the debt in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a debt collector you have never dealt with is reporting an account on your credit file. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please dispute the account with the credit reporting companies and ask the collector in writing who the original creditor is. While the dispute is being investigated, it is marked on your report. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for disputing a $710.00 charge-off that you believe has repeated notations and an unverifiable past-due amount. We understand you want the full account history. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a copy of your direct dispute, and also dispute the account with the credit reporting companies. If you disagree with the outcome, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you sent an identity theft dispute with your Identity Theft Report over 55 days ago and have received no response, while the account is still collected and reported. We understand how frustrating this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep proof of the date your dispute was received, and also dispute the account with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that two collection accounts, one with a $540.00 balance and one with a zero balance, were reported without notice or validation. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Collectors must give you basic information about each debt, so keep copies of your validation requests and dispute both accounts with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that collections from identity theft keep being verified despite your identity theft report. We understand how frustrating it is to see your score keep falling. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send each company your identity theft report from the federal identity theft website with a list of the accounts, and keep reviewing your credit reports for changes. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you are being asked to pay $1,600.00 in towing and storage charges for a vehicle you do not own and did not have towed. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep your written dispute, the collector's response, and any records showing the vehicle is not yours, and continue to dispute in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that over $970.00 was taken from your account without agreement after you asked for a lower payment, and that the collector then called you many times and contacted your father. We understand how distressing this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep your bank records and a call log, and ask for any payment plan terms in writing before agreeing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you requested validation of accounts you believe are not fully accurate. We understand you want proof before anything else happens. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a copy of your request and the date it was received. If you want the collector to stop contacting you, you can also tell them so in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a rental balance is reported under your name even though you were told you would not be on the lease, and that the leaseholder change was made without your consent. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please ask the collector in writing for a copy of any lease or agreement you signed and an itemized balance, and keep your own records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a debt collector you have never dealt with is reporting an account on your credit file. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Accounts are often sold to collectors and appear under a new name, so please ask the collector in writing for the original creditor, and dispute the entry if you do not recognize it. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that an account on your credit report is not yours, that the company's phone number and website do not work, and that your disputes have been denied. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. A legitimate collector should identify itself and the debt, so keep records of your attempts and dispute again in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a rental collection was relabeled with a new creditor name and updated date after your dispute, rather than being corrected. We understand your concern about how it is reported. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please dispute the account with each credit reporting company, showing the earlier and current entries side by side, and keep copies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you disputed the amount of an $890.00 debt, and that the collector then called several times a day and told you non-payment was a crime. We understand how upsetting this was. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep your bank statements showing your payments and a log of the calls, and send your dispute about the amount in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collection account is reported without payment history, a final bill or service period, and that your disputes return as verified without documentation. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep your older and current reports and your autopay records, and send the collector a written dispute asking for an itemized final bill. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a debt collector you do not know is reporting an account on your credit file. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Collectors sometimes buy or are assigned debts, which is why the name may be unfamiliar, so ask in writing for the original creditor and dispute the entry if it is not yours. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a solar project was cancelled before any work was done, yet the loan remains active on your credit report while the lender and contractor refer you to each other. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep the contractor's written cancellation confirmation and send it to the lender with a written request to close the loan. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a collector threatened you with jail, calls at two and three in the morning, and would not give you an address for your validation letter. We understand how frightening this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a log of the calls with dates and times. You can send a letter asking the collector to stop contacting you, and file your police report. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collector took you to court over a debt and that the documents you received were blank or hard to read. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please ask the collector in writing for clear copies of the documents that show the debt and how it came to them, and keep copies of what you received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that a debt collector you have never had an account with is reporting on your credit file. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please check your report for other common errors, ask the collector in writing for the original creditor and account details, and dispute the entry with the credit reporting companies. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collection account has stayed on your reports since 2023 despite disputes, and that its open and last activity dates differ across bureaus. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please dispute the inconsistent dates with each bureau and include copies of the reports that show them. You can request a reinvestigation if you disagree. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an account you did not authorize appeared on your report without notice and is preventing you from buying a home. We understand the urgency. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send the collector a written dispute, and dispute the account with each credit reporting company. If you disagree with the outcome, you can request a reinvestigation. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for sharing your request for validation, including the original creditor, a detailed accounting and payment history. We understand you want the debt confirmed. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep a copy of your request and proof of when it was received. If the reply does not show the debt is yours, continue to dispute it in writing. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a collector has repeatedly called your relatives and their employers, even though it already has your contact details. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Collectors generally may contact others only to find out where you live or work, so please keep a record of each call your relatives received. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a $5,300.00 charge-off remains on all three credit reports after several automated disputes. We understand the effect on your scores. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send a written dispute to each credit reporting company explaining why the account is wrong, with any supporting documents, rather than relying only on online forms. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for telling us that several accounts on your report are not recognized, inaccurate or cannot be verified. We understand you want them investigated. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please list each account and explain what is wrong. If the company that supplied the information finds it was wrong, it must tell every credit reporting company it reported to. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that the collector is asking for the wrong amount even though the correct amount appears on the ledger, and that it has not followed up with you. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team, including the balance. Please send your proof of the correct amount in writing and ask for an itemized statement of the balance. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you paid two collection agencies a total of about $4,200.00, but the creditor has no record of the payments made to the first agency. We understand how worrying this is after years of payments. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please gather your bank statements or receipts for every payment and send copies with a written dispute of the remaining balance. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
